summary: Iteration 141 — validated the 3 new Cyber Crisis Commander features (Live Incident Feed inbound webhook, Board Snapshot public link, scripted Sample Breach scenario) end-to-end across backend + frontend. All 9 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iter141_crisis_webhook_snapshot_scenario.py PASSED. Playwright drove the UI: Incident Command tab renders crisis-webhook-feed with the POST URL, masked secret + Show toggle (reveals whk_… prefix), Copy and Rotate (rotation changes the secret). 'Sample Breach' header button starts the scenario, auto-switches to Timeline tab, controls appear (Play/Pause/Step/Progress/Stop). Progress advanced Step 1/9 → 3/9 via ~4s auto-play, then Step to 4/9 manually. Share Snapshot creates crisis-snapshot-bar with URL + Copy + Revoke; opening the /crisis-snapshot/<token> URL in a fresh no-cookie browser context rendered the public read-only page (data-testid crisis-snapshot) with title/severity/timeline. Revoke removes the bar and the same URL then renders crisis-snapshot-error. Bogus token also renders crisis-snapshot-error. Public API endpoints /api/crisis/ingest/webhook and /api/crisis/public/snapshot/{token} confirmed working WITHOUT auth cookies (verified via a cookie-less requests.Session and a fresh Playwright browser context). Cleanup executed: POST /api/crisis/scenario/stop + POST /api/crisis/demo/clear (both returned cleared/stopped totals of 0).
critical_code_review_comments: Public snapshot endpoint returns 404 when the underlying case has been deleted (e.g. after POST /crisis/scenario/stop) — this is technically correct but surfaces as 'Snapshot unavailable' on a link the user may have already shared. Consider soft-deleting cases so revoked/expired vs 'case missing' can be distinguished in the UX message.

CyberCrisisCommander.jsx is very large (>1500 lines with WebhookFeed, scenario controls, snapshot bar, and full tab shell all inline). Extracting SnapshotBar + ScenarioControls into components would help readability and testability.
